roadmap.title: Story and early unlocks
roadmap.description: Play the story and pick up the one-time actions along the way: first structure, boots, sleep, lost cargo, music player, hot spring, BB care and the first connections.

roadmap.title: Deliveries, likes and facility levels
roadmap.description: Switch to Hard, finish the story orders, then work through standard and premium orders to raise every facility to five stars and fill the cargo, likes and grade counters.

roadmap.title: Memory chips and Director's Cut content
roadmap.description: Collect all 56 memory chips and complete the new Director's Cut orders that unlock the extra structures.

roadmap.title: Upgrades, fabrication and final unlock
roadmap.description: Upgrade every structure to level 3, fabricate every item, then unlock the last achievement.

steps.text: Unlock the other 62 achievements; this one unlocks on its own with the last of them.

achievements.summary: Complete one standard order.

steps.text: In Episode 2, complete @mechanic{[Order No. 9] Power Supply Unit Delivery: Wind Farm}. This opens standard orders.
At any terminal, accept a standard order under @mechanic{Orders for Sam} and deliver it.

achievements.summary: Complete 36 standard orders.

guide.context: Use 36 different orders, because repeating the same order may not count. Standard orders keep respawning, so you never run out.

steps.text: Accept standard orders at terminals whenever you have free carrying space on your back or vehicle.
To check the count, open the world map, then @mechanic{Bridge Links}, your ID and @mechanic{Orders}.

achievements.description: Complete at least 10 unique premium deliveries in each order category with an evaluation of "Legend," "Legend of Legends," or "Legend of Legends of Legends."
achievements.summary: Complete 10 different premium deliveries in each of the four order categories with a rating of Legend or higher.

guide.context: Only standard orders count, not story orders. Each counted order must be different, and repeating an order adds nothing. The four categories are Condition, Quantity, Miscellaneous and Time. The icon next to an order shows its category.

steps.text: Finish the story order @mechanic{Prototype Bot Delivery} in Episode 3 to unlock premium deliveries.
Play on Normal or higher. Normal gives the Legend rating, which is enough here.
At a terminal, select a standard order and choose @mechanic{Select Premium Delivery}.
Deliver 10 different premium orders per category and reach a rating of Legend or higher on each.
steps.note: An order you already finished shows @mechanic{Premium Delivery: Completed} and its rating under Best Performance.

steps.text: To check progress, open the world map, then @mechanic{Bridge Links}, your ID and @mechanic{Orders}.

achievements.description: Complete at least 20 unique premium deliveries in each order category with an evaluation of "Legend of Legends" or "Legend of Legends of Legends."
achievements.summary: Complete 20 different premium deliveries in each of the four order categories with a rating of Legend of Legends or higher.

guide.context: Only standard orders count, not story orders, and each counted order must be different. That makes 80 orders in all, 20 for each of Condition, Quantity, Miscellaneous and Time. Legend alone does not count. Hard gives the Legend of Legends rating. Hard changes only combat, so you can drop to Very Easy for boss fights without losing progress.

steps.text: Set the difficulty to Hard or higher.
At a terminal, select a standard order and choose @mechanic{Select Premium Delivery}. The icon next to the order shows its category.
Deliver 20 different premium orders per category and reach an S rank (Legend of Legends) on each.
To check progress, open the world map, then @mechanic{Bridge Links}, your ID and @mechanic{Orders}.

achievements.summary: Post a supply request while online.

guide.context: This needs the online servers. The feature opens once you arrive at the Wind Farm in Episode 2.

steps.text: Open @mechanic{Options}, then @mechanic{Supply Requests}. Choose an item and a destination facility, then post the request.
steps.note: The request does not need to be fulfilled.

achievements.description: Complete a standard order with a delivery bot.
achievements.summary: Complete a standard order using a delivery bot.

guide.context: The tutorial bot order does not count. The bot needs about an hour to finish.

steps.text: Finish the story order @mechanic{Prototype Bot Delivery} at the @loc{Distribution Center South of Lake Knot City} (Episode 3).
At a terminal, choose @mechanic{Standard Orders (Bot-deliverable)} and send the bot.
After about an hour, complete another order or open a terminal. The bot's rewards screen unlocks the achievement.

achievements.description: Complete your first structure (signs, ladders, and climbing anchors also count.)
achievements.summary: Build any structure, including a sign, ladder or climbing anchor.

steps.text: Open the structure menu and place a sign. It costs nothing and can go anywhere.

achievements.description: Complete at least one of every type of structure (including signs, ladders, and climbing anchors.)
achievements.summary: Build at least one of each of the 13 structure types, including signs, ladders and climbing anchors.

guide.context: Build the Bridge and Safehouse again on your own, because the ones from tutorial orders may not count. The Jump Ramp and Chiral Bridge come from new Director's Cut orders.

steps.text: Fabricate a @item{Ladder} and a @item{Climbing Anchor} at a terminal, and place a sign.
Fabricate a @item{PCC} at a terminal and use it to build the other structures. Level 1 comes with order No. 5 and level 2 with order No. 27.
With a PCC level 1, build a @item{Bridge}, @item{Postbox}, @item{Generator}, @item{Watchtower} and @item{Timefall Shelter}.
With a PCC level 2, build a @item{Safehouse}, @item{Zipline} and @item{Cargo Catapult}.

Start order No. 77 at the western distribution center near @loc{Capital Knot City}, then finish orders No. 77, 78 and 79. Sleep in a private room, then finish order No. 80 from the @loc{Weather Station} to unlock the @item{Jump Ramp}. Build it.
Sleep again and go to the @loc{Chiral Artist's Studio}. Finish order No. 81 to unlock the @item{Chiral Bridge}. Build it.

achievements.displayName: A New Day for the UCA
achievements.description: Connect your first new affiliate to the UCA.
achievements.summary: Bring the first new facility into the UCA network.

steps.text: In Episode 2, take order No. 4 and bring the chiral network to @loc{Waystation West of Capital Knot City}.

achievements.description: Connect all facilities to the UCA.
achievements.summary: Connect every facility to the UCA.

guide.context: Most facilities join during the story. A prepper joins the UCA at 2 stars. At 1 star they only try the chiral network. Raise a facility's stars by delivering orders to it.

steps.text: On the map, press the facility filter button twice. Facilities you have not found yet appear greyed out.
In the Eastern Region, find @npc{The Musician} and @npc{Ludens Fan}. Both live near @loc{Distribution Center West of Capital Knot City}, with The Musician to the west and Ludens Fan to the east.
In the Central Region, find @npc{The Collector}, who lives below @loc{Distribution Center South of Lake Knot City}; also find @npc{The Veteran Porter}, who lives northwest of the @loc{Timefall Farm}.
Also find @npc{The Novelist's Son}, who lives near @loc{Distribution Center North of Mountain Knot City} to the southwest, and @npc{The First Prepper}, who lives south of the Spiritualist.
Peter Englert and the Cosplayer are the other optional facilities to connect, if the story has not already done it.
Deliver orders to each one until it reaches 2 stars.

achievements.description: Reach connection level three with a facility.
achievements.summary: Raise any facility to connection level 3.

steps.text: Deliver orders to any facility until its connection shows 3 stars. The story does this on its own.

achievements.description: Reach the maximum connection level with all facilities.
achievements.estTime: biggest grind in the game, 40+ hours
achievements.summary: Raise every facility to its maximum connection level (5 stars).

guide.context: This is the longest grind in the game. Each facility needs a different number of Likes, and deliveries to it give the Likes. Heavy loads of 300 kg or more give many more Likes than small ones.

steps.text: Finish the story first so every main facility is connected.
Build a zipline network between facilities. Cargo weight does not slow you on a zipline, and BTs cannot reach you there.
Take heavy standard orders and set them to premium on Hard difficulty for more Likes.
Repeat until every facility shows 5 stars on the map.
steps.note: Each 5-star facility also gives a star patch for the suit.

achievements.summary: Give a Like to a structure or sign that someone else placed.

steps.text: Stand next to a structure or sign placed by another porter or an NPC and press the Like button.
steps.note: This works offline, because NPCs also leave structures. Passing a sign can give a Like on its own.

achievements.description: Reach a total of 2,400 Likes on the Results Screen.
achievements.summary: Earn 2,400 Likes in total, as the results screen counts them.

guide.context: Online and offline Likes both count.

steps.text: Complete orders until your total Likes reach 2,400. The total shows on the world map.

achievements.description: Reach a total of 50,000 Likes on the Results Screen.
achievements.summary: Earn 50,000 Likes in total, as the results screen counts them.

guide.context: Online and offline Likes both count. The achievement unlocks on the results screen after an order.

steps.text: Complete orders until your total Likes reach 50,000. The total shows on the world map.
steps.note: The facility grind for Best Beloved gets you there.

achievements.description: Deliver your first piece of lost cargo.
achievements.summary: Deliver a piece of lost cargo to the facility that wants it.

steps.text: Scan with the Odradek to find lost cargo. Its name shows the facility that wants it.
Pick it up and deliver it to that facility.

achievements.description: Make your first donation of weapons, equipment, etc.
achievements.summary: Donate a weapon or piece of equipment to the shared locker while online.

guide.context: This needs the online servers. Share lockers unlock in Episode 2 after order No. 4.

steps.text: Use a terminal. Open @mechanic{Share Locker}, then @mechanic{Donate Weapons & Equipment}. Pick one item and hold the confirm button.

achievements.summary: Recycle chiral crystals once.

steps.text: In Episode 2, finish the story order @mechanic{[Order No. 8] Collection: Chiral Crystals} from the @loc{Distribution Center West of Capital Knot City}. It teaches you to harvest and recycle crystals.

achievements.summary: Restore one memory chip.

guide.context: Some chips appear only after a nearby facility emails you about a glowing object.

steps.text: Scan with the Odradek to find a memory chip and retrieve it.

achievements.summary: Restore all 56 memory chips.

guide.context: Some chips show up only after a nearby facility emails you about a glowing object. Read every email you have, keep delivering to that facility and sleep in a private room so new mail arrives. Chips are numbered by region here. Each note also gives the chip's number in the game's own list.

achievements.description: Acquire your first piece of customization data.
achievements.summary: Get your first piece of customization data.

steps.text: Deliver orders to facilities until a connection level rises and you receive customization data.
steps.note: Bridges Guard: Macho is one such reward, given at level 3 by the western distribution center near Capital Knot City.

achievements.description: Take your first hot spring bath.
achievements.summary: Take a bath in a hot spring.

steps.text: Walk into any hot spring, press the sit button, then press it again to stand up.
steps.note: The Crater Digestive Bath is one; find it midway from the Junk Dealer to the Film Director.

achievements.summary: Read 100 emails.

guide.context: Mail is delivered when you sleep in a private room. It comes from story orders and from facility level-ups. Raising every facility gives about 180 emails.

steps.text: Complete orders and raise facilities, sleeping in a private room to receive mail.
Open the world map, choose @mechanic{Mail} and read each email.

achievements.estTime: comes with chips and facility grind
achievements.summary: Read 100 interviews.

guide.context: Interviews come from story orders, facility levels and three memory chips: the ones at the ruined mall north of the Craftsman, the South Knot City ruins and Peter Englert's shelter.

steps.text: Raise facilities, finish the story and restore the three chips named above.
Open the world map, choose @mechanic{Data}, then @mechanic{Interviews}, and read each one.

achievements.description: Help porters through a MULE or terrorist area for the first time.
achievements.summary: Stun every enemy in a MULE or terrorist camp so porters can pass.

guide.context: The Non-Lethal Assault Rifle from Episode 4 (order No. 41) helps. Switch it to rubber bullets on the weapon wheel. Bare hands, thrown cargo and ramming with a vehicle also stun enemies. Avoid lethal kills, which can cause a voidout.

steps.text: Go to a MULE or terrorist camp, shown with an orange outline on the map. A good first choice is the small camp below @loc{Lake Knot City}; it has few guards and no trucks.
Stun every enemy in that one camp. Use the Odradek to find any that are hiding.
The message about porters being able to traverse the area confirms it.

achievements.description: Reach maximum connection level with BB.
achievements.summary: Raise your connection level with BB to the maximum.

guide.context: BB's level rises over time as you walk and deliver. Do not let BB's health reach zero, because that lowers the level sharply. If it does, sleep in a private room right away.

steps.text: Keep BB's health up. Soothe BB whenever it cries.
Earn Likes from BB with mirror photos in your private room, fast movement on vehicles, ziplines or skeletons, and by killing large BTs.
steps.note: The harmonica from @npc{The Musician} also gives BB Likes.

steps.text: To check the level, open the world map, then @mechanic{Bridge Links}, your ID, @mechanic{Delivery Stats} and BB Connection Level.

achievements.summary: Receive a Like from BB.

steps.text: In your private room, face the mirror at the sink. Use the right stick to make a move, then take a photo of Sam.
steps.note: Jumping a long way with a Speed Skeleton also works.

achievements.description: Reach Grade 10 in any delivery evaluation category.
achievements.summary: Raise any one delivery evaluation category to Grade 10.

steps.text: Complete orders until one delivery category reaches Grade 10 on the results screen.

achievements.description: Reach Grade 60 in all delivery evaluation categories.
achievements.summary: Reach Grade 60 in every delivery evaluation category.

guide.context: This needs the online servers. The five categories are Condition, Quantity, Miscellaneous, Time and Bridge Link. Bridge Link comes only from Likes that other players give you.

steps.text: For Condition, take orders marked Fragile. A truck keeps cargo safe unless you drive it off a cliff.
For Quantity, deliver heavy loads, ideally by truck.
For Time, take orders with a time limit.
For Miscellaneous, do any order that is not Condition, Quantity or Time.
For Bridge Link, build roads and other structures that players will use, and donate crafted items to the shared online locker.
steps.note: It takes about 20,000 to 25,000 online Likes. The grade updates when you complete a delivery.

steps.text: Check each grade on the results screen after finishing an order.

achievements.summary: Defeat a Catcher.

steps.text: In Episode 2 (order No. 16), defeat the Catcher at the end of the order. Open the weapon wheel, select grenades and throw them at it.

achievements.description: Heal by sleeping for the first time.
achievements.summary: Sleep to heal Sam for the first time.

guide.context: Sleeping only works when no threat, such as rain or BTs, is nearby.

steps.text: Put your cargo down, hold the sit button, then hold the sleep button until Sam rests.

achievements.displayName: Boots Are a Porter's Best Friend
achievements.description: Change footwear for the first time.
achievements.summary: Change Sam's footwear for the first time.

steps.text: After order No. 7 in Episode 2, fabricate boots at a terminal. They cost 8 Resins.
steps.note: Boots found in the world or dropped by enemies also work.

steps.text: Open @mechanic{Options}, then @mechanic{Cargo}, select the boots and choose @mechanic{Put on Footwear}.

achievements.summary: Deliver 700 pieces of cargo in total.

steps.text: Keep completing orders. Raising every facility to 5 stars gives far more than 700.
steps.note: To check the count, open the world map, then @mechanic{Bridge Links}, your ID and @mechanic{Orders}.

achievements.summary: Deliver 3,000 kg of cargo in total.

steps.text: Keep completing orders. Raising every facility to 5 stars gives far more than 3,000 kg.
steps.note: To check the total, open the world map, then @mechanic{Bridge Links}, your ID and @mechanic{Orders}.

achievements.description: Travel 80 km and complete an order.
achievements.summary: Travel a total of 80 km, then complete an order.

guide.context: The distance adds up over the whole game, not in one order. The story covers it.

steps.text: Keep playing, then complete an order after passing 80 km. The reward screen unlocks the achievement.
steps.note: To check the distance, open the world map, then @mechanic{Bridge Links}, your ID and @mechanic{Delivery Stats}.

achievements.summary: Enter Higgs's home inside Peter Englert's shelter.

guide.context: Finish the story and all of Peter Englert's pizza deliveries, and the door will be open. You can still do this after the story.

steps.text: Go to @npc{Peter Englert}'s shelter in the Central Region, directly west of @loc{Lake Knot City}.
Once the door is open, go inside to find Higgs's home.

achievements.description: In a BT area, cut an umbilical cord for the first time without the BT noticing.
achievements.summary: In a BT area, cut a BT's umbilical cord without being noticed.

guide.context: You need the Cord Cutter. You get it from @npc{Mama}'s lab in Episode 5, after order No. 46.

steps.text: Go to a BT area. BTs appear in rainy areas. Stand still and scan with the Odradek to see them.
Crouch and move slowly toward a BT. Hold your breath from time to time.
When the cut-umbilical-cord prompt appears, use it before the BT notices you.

achievements.description: Trade with another porter for the first time.
achievements.summary: Trade cargo with an NPC porter.

guide.context: NPC porters walk the Central Region in groups of two or three. They are most common in the eastern half, near the Engineer, Craftsman, Elder, Film Director and Junk Dealer. They do not go to the snowy mountains.

steps.text: Find a group of NPC porters and give them Likes.
Equip a piece of cargo in one hand and put it on the ground in front of them.
Keep offering cargo until a porter holds out their own. Accept it to unlock the achievement.

achievements.description: Soothe a crying BB and stop the crying for the first time.
achievements.summary: Stop BB's crying by soothing BB.

steps.text: Make BB cry by tripping and falling, or by fighting BTs.
Open the compass, take BB, hold the soothe button and move the stick or controller up and down until the crying stops.

achievements.description: Send a shout out and have it returned for the first time.
achievements.summary: Send a shout and get a shout back.

guide.context: This needs the online servers. Not every shout gets an answer.

steps.text: Press the shout button (key 5 on keyboard, touchpad on PlayStation) in different places until a reply comes back.

achievements.description: Dispose of chiralium-contaminated cargo in the crater lake for the first time.
achievements.summary: Throw chiralium-contaminated cargo into the crater lake.

steps.text: Go to the @npc{Junk Dealer} in the Central Region and pick up contaminated cargo from next to his shelter.
Carry it to the lake directly south, equip it in your hand and throw it in.

achievements.description: Upgrade all types of structure to the maximum level.
achievements.summary: Upgrade each of the 10 upgradable structure types to level 3.

guide.context: The 10 types are Generator, Watchtower, Safehouse, Timefall Shelter, Zipline, Postbox, Bridge, Cargo Catapult, Jump Ramp and Chiral Bridge. Roads cannot be upgraded. Upgrading your own structures counts.

steps.text: Build every type you do not have yet. See Master Builder for the three new ones.
Stand at one of your structures, hold the Options menu and choose @mechanic{Upgrade Structure}. Repeat until it reaches level 3.
Upgrade costs for the original seven structures. Generator: level 2 is 400 Metals, level 3 is 100 Chiral Crystals and 400 Metals. Postbox: level 2 is 200 Metals, level 3 is 600 Metals.
steps.note: Save by hand first, claim materials at facility terminals, upgrade, then reload to get the materials back.

steps.text: Watchtower: level 2 is 32 Chiral Crystals and 400 Metals, level 3 is 150 Chiral Crystals and 800 Metals. Timefall Shelter: level 2 is 32 Chiral Crystals and 400 Metals, level 3 is 300 Chiral Crystals and 1,200 Metals.
Zipline: level 2 is 240 Chemicals and 480 Special Alloys, level 3 is 300 Chiral Crystals, 1,440 Chemicals and 1,440 Special Alloys.

Safehouse and Bridge list a level 1 cost too. Safehouse: level 1 is 300 Chiral Crystals and 2,400 Special Alloys, level 2 is 500 and 4,500, level 3 is 1,000 and 6,840. Bridge: level 1 is 800 Metals, level 2 is 96 Chiral Crystals and 1,600 Metals, level 3 is 500 Chiral Crystals and 2,800 Metals.

achievements.description: Pee outside for the first time.
achievements.summary: Urinate outdoors.

steps.text: Outside, equip the urinate symbol, aim, and hold the button until Sam finishes. The toilet in your private room does not count.

achievements.displayName: All Roads Lead to the UCA
achievements.summary: Complete your first road.

steps.text: In Episode 3, take order No. 25 @mechanic{Road Reconstruction} at @loc{Lake Knot City} and finish building the road.

achievements.description: Use the music player for the first time.
achievements.summary: Play a song on the music player.

steps.text: In your private room, interact with the wall map, open @mechanic{Music Player} and play any song. It unlocks at the start of Act 2.

achievements.summary: Reach Bridge Link Grade 1 while online.

guide.context: This needs the online servers. Bridge Links unlock after the Wind Farm order in Episode 2.

steps.text: Stay logged in to the servers while you complete orders.
Like other players' structures and build things they will use.
Finish an order. Your Bridge Link grade updates on the results screen.
steps.note: Bridge Link is the star's top point on that screen.

achievements.description: Fabricate all available weapons and equipment.
achievements.summary: Fabricate every weapon, piece of equipment and vehicle available in the Director's Cut.

guide.context: There are 108 items, and each must be fabricated at least once. A checked box in an item's description shows it was made. Put each piece of equipment in your backpack once, and drive each vehicle once. Vehicles cannot be recycled and garage space is limited, so free a slot before building the next one.

steps.text: Unlock the plans: raise all facilities to 5 stars, finish the story and every order for Sam, and restore chip 31 in the game's chip list (it gives the Reverse Trike Ride Type plan).
steps.note: Oxygen Mask, Power Gloves and Thermal Pad can only be made in the snowy mountain region.

steps.text: Finish the new orders. No. 77 unlocks the @item{Maser Gun} and @item{Support Skeleton}. No. 83 unlocks the @item{Buddy Bot}.

Take order No. 35 at the @loc{Distribution Center South of Lake Knot City}, then build the race track south of the @loc{Timefall Farm} (650 Chiral Crystals, 2,240 Metals, 1,960 Ceramics). Any S rank on a Roadster race unlocks the @item{Roadster}. An S rank on every Roadster race unlocks the @item{Roadster Long Range}.

Finish the lambda orders that send you to cubes. Cube 1 is on the riverbank, a little north from @loc{Distribution Center West of Capital Knot City}, and gives Gordon Freeman's glasses. Cube 3 is in a MULE camp close to @loc{Distribution Center South of Lake Knot City}, on its northwest side, and gives the @item{Gravity Gloves}. Cube 4 is west-northwest of the Craftsman's bunker and gives the @item{Truck lambda Type}.
steps.note: Cube 2, beside Peter Englert's bunker, gives no item but leads to the next cube.

steps.text: Finish the Cyberpunk orders. No. 72 takes you to the MULE camp below @loc{Lake Knot City} for the @item{Reverse Trike Yaiba Kusanagi}. No. 73 and No. 74 take you to the MULE camp on the northern side of @loc{Mountain Knot City} for Johnny's Sunglasses and the @item{Silver Hand}.
steps.note: Order No. 71 comes first and gives no item.

steps.text: Fabricate Gold and Silver copies of each Armor Plate (levels 1 to 4). Do the same for three skeleton types, levels 1 to 3: All Terrain, Power and Speed.
steps.note: The Reverse Trike Transporter is available from the start.

steps.text: Open a terminal's fabrication list and check for items without a checkmark. Fabricate those.
